notes:
West strip of 22-35N (x 0-3400). Spellings copied from picks22/s22-35L.json (same plate, other image) so names join. Printed on this image: W. McMICKEN AVE. (north part printed only AVENUE), DIXMYTH, BOLLES ST., HOPPLE ST., RACHEL ST., TOWNSHIP ST., BADER ST., MASSACHUSETTS AVE., MARSHALL AVE., CLIFTON VIEW AV., TAYLOR AVE., RIDDLE / ROAD / ST. (the zigzag), FOULKE ST., DECKEBACH, PROBASCO, PROBASCO COURT, DUKE ST., HULL ST., GIRAUD, ENSLIN ST., TAFEL ST., WAGNER ST., MO.. (stub north of Dixmyth = Morrison Avenue per 35L), CORM.. / AVENUE (= Cormany Avenue). Straight Street and Luna Avenue are not printed in this strip (plate clipped); names taken from 35L.
Gilmore Street follows 35L: the old Miami & Erie canal bed strip, printed only STREET between Hopple and Rachel, OLD BED MIAMI AND ERIE CANAL further south, GILMORE south of Bader. Points at Hopple, Rachel and Bader are on the middle of the strip; at Hopple the strip's west edge is the image clip, so the middle is uncertain (east-40-ft alternative ~(793,2328)). At Marshall the strip opens into a wide triangle; the point is on Gilmore proper ~20 ft off the east lots along the 4 in pipe (middle-of-triangle alternative ~(1440,5470)). North of Hopple the canal bed continues as open ground (not a street).
West McMicken Avenue carries a railroad in the street; between Hopple and Riddle the centre is taken between the block lines. At Riddle the east line north of Riddle is ~1435 and south of Riddle ~1500 (centre taken ~1448). North of Dixmyth a lot strip is marked DED. FOR STREET (street widening), not a separate street.
Riddle Road meets McMicken on a NE diagonal; its north line is the Weisenberger lot line (the line under 6 in W. PIPE is the pipe). Riddle/Foulke T is at the ST. jog. Deckebach continues the SE diagonal straight south; Riddle turns E there.
Marshall Avenue: E-W piece Massachusetts-McMicken (south line = image clip), then NE piece east of McMicken (crosses McMicken; the west and east centrelines meet McMicken ~15 px apart, point between). Giraud leaves the NE piece eastward (T). Marshall's southern N-S piece (Foulke, Riddle, Probasco crossings) lies at x ~3580, outside this strip.
Clifton View/Taylor is an L corner (Taylor turns into Clifton View); Clifton View ends at Marshall. Taylor/Foulke: Foulke east piece starts at Taylor's foot.
Giraud's south line is not drawn east of Enslin; Giraud/Enslin and Giraud/Wagner centres use its north line plus 60 ft (as 35L did).
Wagner Street runs Giraud-Tafel-Straight; Tafel ends at Wagner (T). Straight/Wagner and Straight/Luna are the same point (Wagner continues south of Straight as Luna per 35L; only a clipped stub is drawn).
Drawn-area stops (not real ends): Massachusetts north of Township and Cormany north of Rachel (short stubs), Rachel, Township, Bader and Marshall west of Massachusetts/Cormany, Morrison north of Dixmyth, McMicken north of y~800 and south of Tafel, Straight west of Wagner.
Massachusetts/Township, Massachusetts/Bader, Massachusetts/Marshall and Cormany/Rachel recorded as cross (the clip shows the side streets continuing a little past them). Massachusetts west line is unclear (clip vs a sewer line); its centre may be off by ~10-15 px.
Not recorded: the sewer/property strip running north from Riddle's ROAD piece at x~2140-2205 (36 in and 12 in sewers), the sewer strip north of Hopple at x~780-800 and the SEWER stub west of Hopple at the clip, unnamed narrow strip running SSE from Hopple at x~1000 (looks like a lot-line pair), Deckebach's pipe strip south of Probasco (Deckebach taken as ending at Probasco, as in 35L), 'W ST.' lettering at the Cormany/Bader corner (owner text, as noted on 35L).
